{{Top|leg}}
An '''aquapod''' was a sealed [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] conveyance that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to harvest [[bestrum algae]] from the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Baralou]] in conjunction with [[Aqualis Base]].
